# Dedicated fixed2029 source author handoff — local checks passed, not release verification

Source `932c28a92fea8ce9c7d96fbecf136f457e8851e1`; tree `035beb2ad18037b4667e55afd40a5a791cf20a86`.
Base public bootstrap `29b751eb87348f62aeb8e66b135e503abeb29ea0`.
Isolated branch/worktree `codex/demo-expiry-2029-author-20261103`, C:/w-rv/auth-expiry-2029-author-20261103. Tracked and untracked status clean at handoff.

Only the four actual writer-amendment paths changed: new controller215lines, helper154, test234 and manual workflow66. No source file reaches500lines. The normal renewal helper remains exactly D2 Gitblob526444974fe4ce08d4e55e57949c8b5f0c9d4f13. No backend/frontend, production workflow, manifest, lockfile, .dockerignore, root packet or another worktree changed.

Read full assigned source31 controller/helper/tests/workflow, actual writer/scope receipts and shared detailed contract before implementation. Shared contract hashbbebaced53dbaffe00b268e64e6081465bd1b7ef539da5a6664ec40b175437f0. Security-audit/SPARC/swarm skills informed strict boundary-first tests and parent-led isolated ownership; no new ledger/swarm writer or external command was created for coordination.

## Source history and actual failures retained

- c197a060e70ec7add744a1ee7ad6ef1599342ba3 adds the dedicated tests. Actual source-bound RED:1 failed test-file load because dedicated modules did not exist. This is missing-feature evidence, not claimed as82 behavioral assertions having executed.
- b347f1aa224dd8548945b45bb9ac04e80272db20 adds controller/helper/workflow adapted from source31's structural patterns. Actual candidate1:134 tests,114 pass,20 fail. Causes were author-generated double escaping in strict date regexes and doubled receipt-code prefix; broad early date rejection meant those passing negative cases alone were not meaningful boundary coverage yet.
- 9282afb597000b762116f82ae333a6686e5f3f4d corrects only those source defects. Candidate2:134/134 pass. No assertions were weakened or removed.
- 932c28a92fea8ce9c7d96fbecf136f457e8851e1 adds cutoff-crossing, true no-authorizer isolation, copied-capability/consumption, missing-run, old-permanent ambiguity, public value-type/spelling and stage-level final-await regressions. Fresh candidate3:152/152 PASS,0 fail/skip/cancel (dedicated82 plus existing ordinary70).

Parent's earlier exploratory ordinary-route26ba86a9 semantic RED remains unchanged in initial-direct-route-red2. The architecture was refined into a distinct route, not an ordinary MAX increase. Its five behavioral requirements remain covered by the dedicated suite: fixed2029 eligibility, authentic capability necessity, old action cannot be reused, exactly one fixed-key stage, and demo-only public/production preflight. Ordinary helper still rejects2029. All old red/failed/green logs remain in their unique original check directories.

## Implemented safety envelope

Fixed constants: EXPIRY_2029=2029-12-31T23:59:59Z, KEY=DEMO_AUTH_EXPIRES_AT, ACTION=enable-demo-auth-2029. No caller date/key/value/target/allowLong/replace input. The dedicated request contains selector subject/nonce/reviewedSha plus owner/ownerNonce, activeDeploymentId/activeSourceSha, previousExpiry, failedDeploymentId/failedSourceSha. New cutoff remains finite/future; canonical controller observations use injected current time and deny once it reaches the cutoff, including after write intent before the final mutation.

Only genuine user-session provenance may authorize the new action. An existing ordinary/permanent capability, a maintainer comment, self-declared JSON/actor or CLI environment is not authority. Reservation binds fixed target/key/date, full request, exact current release/owner/parent-source/prior-operations digests, budget=null. Default CLI supplies no authorization verifier; authentic action consumption must occur through the trusted host after review/release gates.

The sole superseded finite stage must belong to parent523/issue522, retain its valid strict seven-day request at its original authorization time, full original audit index/history, request digest, authorization binding, execution and protected-demo-deploy authorization. It must match the new previousExpiry and failedSourceSha. Exactly one unambiguous staged finite operation and failed deploy is required; no prior receipt is rewritten. Missing/parallel/claimed/write-intent/uncertain or unresolved fixed/permanent/exact dispatch state blocks. Current user capability freezes all prior records; later drift invalidates it.

The native failed-run reader must prove exact run ID, attempt1, completed FAILURE for the bound deploy source, repository, trusted workflow, event, main branch and exact dispatch title. Matching Railway latest FAILED deployment ID and source are separately proved using fixed-target read-only metadata. The query fields are the same id/status/projectId/environmentId/serviceId/meta already used by D2's DEPLOYMENT_QUERY; no guessed field, variable inventory or raw log reader was added.

Every target inspection requires idle dedicated synthetic demo, the exact old active different source, exact public expired previous cutoff (only seconds or .000Z equivalent), disabled/simulatorfalse/temporaryfalse, healthy demo readiness and current main. This cannot fake the old active cutoff as the acknowledged-but-unapplied Nov9 stage. Fixed failed/source/target proofs and old public expiry enter the fingerprint.

Existing source31 release checks remain: independently reviewed child525 source, published unchanged feedback, real Max round>=3 and exact final Codex/review proof, merged source-tree equivalence and fresh main, maintainer/revocation checks. CAS claim, durable intent, final permission-await owner/prior-history observation, one fixed-key variableUpsert and skipDeploys=true remain. Write uncertainty or acknowledgment persistence failure is never replayed or relabeled success. Inspect is default and performs no capability consumption/write.

Manual workflow is exact trusted-main/first-attempt/owner/workflowSHA, pinned action SHAs, shared railway-demo queue, fixed protected demo environment, credential-free tests before dedicated demo token. It never uses the production token, allows arbitrary workflow input dates, deploys, migrates or cleans data. Finite receipts permit only bounded whitelisted fields and fixed newExpiry, with raw/normalized credential reflection checks.

## Validation and evidence

All four runs used parent's trusted D2 createRunner in verification mode, no inherited service credentials and clean source HEAD/index before/after. Full command arguments, source hashes/blobs, receipt/log hashes and actual summaries are in source-and-execution-evidence.json. Node syntax checks and git diff --check passed. Tests use isolated in-memory canonical/HTTP/GraphQL/run fixtures; synthetic review objects are explicitly fixture data, not claimed provider approvals. The old ordinary suite's own bounded temporary CLI test also ran; no clinical data or provider action ran.

Frozen author source changed no review/implementation budget. This remains the one ongoing fifth implementation under owner370d013d-26dc-4ef7-8440-1e24d55121ee; old31 candidate and PR527 history untouched. Four source commits are intentionally retained rather than squashed over failed candidates.

## Pending handoff gates

This is author local validation, not independent QA, exact integrated-head CI, real Max round3, final Codex approval, source merge, configuration stage, deployment or online resolution. Root must integrate within the same fifth attempt, preserve its ordinary-regression/additional tests, independently review security and full context, and exercise all protected gates. Root owns .dockerignore/build-context/CI/evidence wiring and actual operational metadata/authority. Existing live UI/public five-role verification is still required after a separately gated deployment. No source31 permanent flags are to be activated.

No provider/API/OAuth/model/probe/dispatch, GitHub/canonical mutation, public comment, actual login, clinical record, SQL cleanup, production action, push/merge/deploy or worktree deletion occurred. Only the four claimed files were locally committed. Final state: IMPLEMENTED — LOCAL CHECKS PASSED; NOT INDEPENDENTLY OR ONLINE VERIFIED.
